questions.question: The quarterly report has been delayed ______ the server outage.
questions.explanation: due to 表原因，后接名词短语，表示“由于”之意。

questions.question: Neither the manager nor the employees _____ ready for the video conference yet.
questions.explanation: “Neither...nor...”与最近的名词(manager)一致，用is。

questions.question: We need to reschedule the meeting; please let me know your _____ next week.
questions.explanation: availability 为可名词化名词，意为“空闲时间”，符合语境。

questions.question: The client asked _____ we could extend the deadline by two weeks.
questions.explanation: asked if 引导间接疑问句，表达“询问是否”。

questions.question: All participants must submit their feedback _____ Friday at 5 p.m.
questions.explanation: by 表截止时间“不迟于”，符合语境。

questions.question: Sales have increased _____ 20 % compared to last quarter.
questions.explanation: increase by 20% 为固定表达，表示增长幅度。

questions.question: By the time the new policy _____ into effect, most departments will have adapted.
questions.explanation: “by the time...”引导的从句用一般现在表示将来。

questions.question: The proposal, along with several _____ recommendations, was discussed at length.
questions.explanation: alternative 为可作定语的形容词，修饰 recommendations。

questions.question: Had we known about the traffic, we _____ earlier.
questions.explanation: “Had we known”为倒装的虚拟条件，对应“would have arrived”。

questions.question: The budget allocated to marketing this year is _____ that of last year.
questions.explanation: budget 为不可数名词，搭配 as much as 比较。

questions.question: The package _____ to the warehouse this morning but was signed for by the wrong person.
questions.explanation: was delivered 为一般过去时，符合整个句子时态。

questions.question: This is the office _____ manager resigned last month.
questions.explanation: where 引导地点关系从句，指“...的办公室”。

questions.question: We greatly appreciate _____ assistance you provided during the audit.
questions.explanation: assistance 为具体的“帮助”，加 the 定冠词。

questions.question: More training opportunities _____ by the HR department next quarter.
questions.explanation: opportunities 为复数，将来被动将用 will be offered。

questions.question: The new hire must _____ the safety protocols before starting work.
questions.explanation: familiarize 作动词含有使役动词须+不定式结构。

questions.question: _____ of the two candidates _____ been selected for the position.
questions.explanation: Either（单数）搭配 has，与“either...or”结构一致。

questions.question: The invoice that you sent _____ differ from the one in our system.
questions.explanation: appear 为一般现在时，描绘目前状态。

questions.question: The team leader suggested _____ discussion _____ after the lunch break.
questions.explanation: suggest that...be postponed 为虚拟建议结构。

questions.question: Our supplier is regarded _____ in the industry.
questions.explanation: be regarded as 为固定搭配。

questions.question: Had the board approved the merger, the company _____ to expand internationally.
questions.explanation: 虚拟条件倒装，对应 would have been ready。

questions.question: This model is no longer in production, so it may not be _____ when needed.
questions.explanation: available 为可及形容词，修饰 it 复合代词。

questions.question: The consultant _____ the client on how to reduce overhead costs.
questions.explanation: advised 为一般过去时，匹配整个句子。

questions.question: The deadline _____ if you submit the required documents tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 条件句用将来时，表示“如果...将...”。

questions.question: Not until 2023 _____ the company achieved its sustainability goals.
questions.explanation: “Not until...”引起的句子使用部分倒装。

questions.question: Each of the new employees _____ completed the onboarding process.
questions.explanation: Each 为单数，搭配 has 完成。

questions.question: The presentation that _____ yesterday _____ well received.
questions.explanation: that 是指 presentation（单数），对应 was given...was。

questions.question: We expect more employees _____ by the end of the year.
questions.explanation: expect to have been hired 表达期望在年底已完成雇佣。

questions.question: _____ the quarterly targets if the trend continues?
questions.explanation: Will we likely meet 为将来疑问式建议结构。

questions.question: The revised contract was signed by all parties, _____ it now awaits final approval.
questions.explanation: and 连接两个并列句，承接合乎逻辑。

questions.question: It is essential _____ punctuality in our daily operations.
questions.explanation: It is essential to do sth 为固定结构。

questions.question: The marketing team _____ different strategies depending on the campaign goals.
questions.explanation: adapts 为一般现在时，描绘惯常行为。

questions.question: The software upgrade will take effect immediately _____ installation.
questions.explanation: upon 表示“在…之时”，固定用法。

questions.question: There are too many applicants _____ position for us to review individually.
questions.explanation: to position 构成 to 不定式结构，“应聘该职位”。

questions.question: The finance director, _____ department has won several awards, will speak at the summit.
questions.explanation: whose 引导定语从句，修饰“部门”。

questions.question: More emphasis _____ on employee development than on profit.
questions.explanation: is laid 被动语态，“放在…上”。

questions.question: I would have attended the seminar _____ not for the urgent client call.
questions.explanation: but for 表示“倘若……就不……”，虚拟条件。

questions.question: The CEO stated that _____ the company's policy would remain unchanged.
questions.explanation: therefore 表结果/因此，承上逻辑。

questions.question: We are looking for someone _____ can handle multiple projects simultaneously.
questions.explanation: who 引导人定语从句。

questions.question: The committee, composed of five members, _____ a unanimous decision yesterday.
questions.explanation: committee 作主语，reached 为一般过去时。
